description.fun: Suicune stands for the rain that put out the Brass Tower fire, and it races across the world following the north wind, walking on water and purifying dirty water with a single touch. Its flowing mane is like the aurora. It was the mascot of Pokémon Crystal, the only member of a legendary trio to front a game without the other two, and its design came together easily, unlike Raikou's.
description.guide: A Water-type Legendary Pokémon, one of Johto's three legendary beasts revived by Ho-Oh after the Brass Tower fire; it represents the rain that put the fire out. It can walk on water and purify it, and is the mascot of Pokémon Crystal. The Paradox Pokémon Walking Wake is said to be an ancient relative.
description.tagline: The north wind's purifier, star of Pokémon Crystal's box
